reason: At src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:503 the patch reads `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` with no guard, but build_integration only adds `sender` when `state.get("sender")` is set (integration.py:376-377), and only the webhook path supplies it (webhook.py:204). An active GitHub Integration that is no longer linked to any organization and has no `sender` therefore raises a KeyError (an HTTP 500); installation.py:44 already guards this same key with `if "sender" not in integration.metadata`.
